name: PlotworkDiagrams
description: Check, sync, validate, render, generate, and drift-check Plotwork diagrams with the pinned command line.
helpMarkDown: Runs the pinned release of [@buun_group/plotwork](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@buun_group/plotwork) with npx. Needs Node 22 or later on the agent: add `UseNode@1` with `version: 22.x` first. [Guide](https://docs.plotwork.dev/diagrams-in-azure-pipelines)
author: Buun Group

groups.name: plotwork
groups.visibleRule: mode = drift || mode = generate || mode = check || mode = validate

inputs.name: mode
inputs.label: Mode

options.check: check: fail on a stale picture or a diagram with an error
options.validate: validate: report errors and warnings, draw nothing
options.sync: sync: redraw the stale pictures in the workspace
options.render: render: draw each .diagram file to SVG in outDir
options.generate: generate: write the diagrams made from files again
options.drift: drift: fail when a diagram made from files has drifted

inputs.helpMarkDown: `check` runs `plotwork sync --check` on the Markdown and `plotwork validate` on each `.diagram` file. `validate` reports errors and warnings. `sync` redraws pictures and commits nothing. `render` draws each `.diagram` file light and dark. `generate` writes the diagrams made from files again and opens a pull request on Azure Repos. `drift` runs `plotwork generate --check` and publishes a JUnit test run.

inputs.name: paths
inputs.label: Markdown files
inputs.visibleRule: mode = check || mode = validate || mode = sync
inputs.helpMarkDown: One glob, file, or folder per line, from the working directory. A line that starts with `!` leaves out what it matches. `node_modules` and `.git` are never searched.

inputs.name: diagrams
inputs.label: .diagram files
inputs.visibleRule: mode = check || mode = validate || mode = render
inputs.helpMarkDown: Standalone `.diagram` files: one glob, file, or folder per line. `check` and `validate` report their errors, and `render` draws them. Empty means none.

inputs.name: outDir
inputs.label: SVG folder
inputs.helpMarkDown: The folder `render` writes to, from the working directory. Each file keeps its folder: `docs/flow.diagram` becomes `<outDir>/docs/flow.svg` and `flow.dark.svg`.

inputs.name: failOn
inputs.label: Fail on

options.error: error: errors, and stale or drifted diagrams in check and drift

inputs.helpMarkDown: Which problems fail the step. Every problem is marked on its line either way.

inputs.name: convertMermaid
inputs.label: Convert Mermaid
inputs.helpMarkDown: Treat each `mermaid` fence that converts to Plotwork as a diagram: `check` reports it as stale, and `sync` replaces it with a `diagram` fence and draws it.

inputs.name: since
inputs.label: Only sources changed since
inputs.helpMarkDown: A git ref, such as `origin/main`: only the sources whose files changed since it run. Check out with `fetchDepth: 0`.

inputs.name: publishTestResults
inputs.label: Publish the JUnit test run
inputs.helpMarkDown: Publish each generated diagram as a test of the run, failed when it drifted.

inputs.name: onDrift
inputs.label: When diagrams drifted

options.pr: pr: open or update one pull request on Azure Repos
options.commit: commit: commit to the branch the run is on
options.fail: fail: fail the step, keep the files and the patch
options.patch: patch: keep the files and the patch, and pass

inputs.helpMarkDown: `pr` and `commit` push with the job's access token and need Azure Repos: grant the project's build service Contribute, Create branch, and Contribute to pull requests on the repository. In any other repository the task keeps the patch and says why. The patch is always the artifact `plotwork`.

inputs.name: prBranch
inputs.label: Pull request branch
inputs.helpMarkDown: The branch the new diagrams are pushed to. The task owns it: each run replaces it with one commit on top of the branch the run is on, and never replaces a branch whose last commit is not Plotwork's.

inputs.name: prTitle
inputs.label: Pull request title
inputs.defaultValue: docs: regenerate diagrams from their sources
inputs.helpMarkDown: The title of the pull request.

inputs.name: commitMessage
inputs.label: Commit message
inputs.defaultValue: docs: regenerate diagrams from their sources
inputs.helpMarkDown: The message of the commit. The task adds the trailer `Plotwork-Generated: true`, by which it knows its own commits.

inputs.name: publish
inputs.label: Publish sources with a publish section
inputs.helpMarkDown: Publish each source of the settings that has a `publish` section to Plotwork, with the key of the service connection or `PLOTWORK_API_KEY`, or with no key as a trusted publisher. Only the generated diagram source is sent, never the files it was made from.

inputs.name: comment
inputs.label: Pull request comment

options.auto: auto: when a diagram drifted or has an error
options.always: always: on every pull request build

inputs.helpMarkDown: On a pull request build in Azure Repos, write one comment with the change table and how to fix it, and edit that same comment on later runs. Needs Contribute to pull requests for the build service.

inputs.name: rulesOrg
inputs.label: Style rules of an organisation
inputs.helpMarkDown: `check` and `validate`: an organisation id or slug whose saved style rules to apply instead of the rules of the settings file, read with the key or as a trusted publisher.

inputs.name: reportDrift
inputs.label: Send the run to the drift dashboard
inputs.helpMarkDown: `drift` and `generate`: send the run's metadata (the repository, the ref and commit, and per source its name, out path, status, change counts, and owners; never a diagram or a file) to the organisation's drift dashboard. A refusal is a note and fails nothing.

inputs.name: plotworkConnection
inputs.label: Plotwork service connection
inputs.helpMarkDown: A Plotwork service connection that holds an organisation API key. Without one, the task reads `PLOTWORK_API_KEY`, which a secret variable must be mapped to with `env:`; with neither, it signs in as a trusted publisher with the job's ID token.

inputs.name: organization
inputs.label: Organisation
inputs.helpMarkDown: The organisation slug the drift report goes to and a trusted publisher signs in to. Empty is `rulesOrg`, then `brand.organization` of the settings, then the organisation of the key.

inputs.name: config
inputs.label: Settings file
inputs.helpMarkDown: The settings file (`plotwork.config.json`). Empty looks for `plotwork.config.json`, then `.plotwork/config.json`, from the working directory up to the repository root.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: The folder to run in, relative to `$(System.DefaultWorkingDirectory)`. Issues and outputs name paths from the repository root.

inputs.name: summary
inputs.label: Write the run summary
inputs.helpMarkDown: Add a Plotwork tab to the run's summary: a table of files, their status, and how to fix each problem.

inputs.name: apiUrl
inputs.label: Plotwork API
inputs.helpMarkDown: The API the task calls. A service connection's address is used when this is left at the default.

inputs.name: cliVersion
inputs.label: Command line release
inputs.helpMarkDown: The release of `@buun_group/plotwork` the task runs with npx. Pin it, and move it in a change you review.

outputVariables.name: stale
outputVariables.description: The diagrams whose picture was missing or out of date (check), redrawn (sync), or drifted from their files (drift, generate).

outputVariables.name: files
outputVariables.description: A JSON array of paths from the repository root: the files to sync (check), the files with an error (validate), or the files written (sync, render, generate).

outputVariables.name: changes
outputVariables.description: drift and generate: a JSON array with one entry per drifted diagram: its source, its out file, the number of changes, and one sentence naming them.

outputVariables.name: pullRequest
outputVariables.description: generate with onDrift pr: the pull request it opened or updated, or empty.

outputVariables.name: published
outputVariables.description: generate with publish: a JSON array of what was published, each with its source name and link.

outputVariables.name: commentUrl
outputVariables.description: drift and generate on a pull request build: the comment it wrote or edited, or empty.

outputVariables.name: driftUrl
outputVariables.description: reportDrift: the drift dashboard the run was sent to.

outputVariables.name: signedInAs
outputVariables.description: A JSON object with the organisation and trusted publisher a run with no key signed in as, or empty.

outputVariables.name: junitFile
outputVariables.description: drift: the JUnit report the task wrote.

outputVariables.name: patchFile
outputVariables.description: generate: the patch of the files the run changed, when it changed any.

outputVariables.name: changedFiles
outputVariables.description: generate: a JSON array of the files the run changed.
